notes: Two bounded measurement-site AOIs for D06 Moon/Mars regolith evidence, issue #170 Goal F.
Planetary frames only. Moon uses IAU_2015:30100; Mars uses IAU_2015:49900. Neither is Earth WGS84.
Values are site/sample-specific, not area averages and not global or exhaustive coverage.

aois.notes: Bounded ~100 m site envelope around the Apollo 15 ALSEP/Station 8 LSRP trench. The PSR places the ALSEP at 26.1341 N, 3.6298 E and the LSRP runs next to a ~40 cm trench. Values are site-specific, not an area average.
Bounded ~100 m site envelope around the InSight lander/HP3 mole site (4.502 N, 135.623 E). Values describe the upper ~40 cm at the lander site, not an area average.
